name: Metalcraft Images
description: Generate, edit, and inspect images via Metalcraft Images (images.metalcraftai.com), which runs fal.ai models through Metalcraft Inference and bills the caller's Metalcraft credits. List models and prices (mimg_list_models), text-to-image (mimg_generate_image), image-to-image edits (mimg_edit_image) from a gallery image, an uploaded file (mimg_upload_image), or a URL, ask a vision model what is in an image (mimg_describe_image), mint a shareable link (mimg_share_image), and browse history (mimg_list_generations, mimg_get_generation). Authenticated by METALCRAFT_TOKEN sent as Authorization: Bearer. Generating, editing, and describing are premium-only and spend credits.
